subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: S&OP Process
description: A quick, practical guide to S&OP Process.

hook.text: Sales wants more inventory. Finance wants less. Operations wants stable production. S&OP aligns them all.

buildup.text: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) is a monthly process that balances demand, supply, and financial plans.

discovery.text: It brings cross-functional teams together to agree on one set of numbers the whole company works from.

twist.text: Without S&OP, each department plans independently. The result: conflicting targets and wasted resources.

climax.text: Companies with mature S&OP see 15–20% better forecast accuracy and fewer costly surprises.

punchline.text: One plan, one number, one team. That's S&OP.

quiz.question: What does S&OP align?
options: Demand, supply, and financial plans across the company
